description: NaSmP₂S₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.42 Å. Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine S atoms. There are a spread of Sm-S bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.40 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one P and three S atoms. The P-P bond length is 2.23 Å. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.04 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one P and three S atoms. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.06 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sm, and one P atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sm, and one P atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sm, and one P atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sm, and one P atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Sm and one P atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sm, and one P atom.
